title: One-bay two-storey frame under lateral joint loads

source.work: Bentley Systems, STAAD.Pro Help, Verification Examples (public documentation, docs.bentley.com)
source.edition: STAAD.Pro Help v21 build (pages refer to the STAAD.Pro 2023 sample files), read 2026-11-22
source.notes: problem statement taken from the vendor page (text and input listing). The page cites: McCormac, Structural Analysis, 3rd ed. 1975, p. 388, example 22-7 - NOT opened for this project; no number is taken from it. The page's 'theory' values are recorded as printed; the program's own results are not used.

analysis: Plane problem in the global X-Y plane (Y vertical); the out-of-plane DOFs (uz, rx, ry) of every node are held; in-plane bending about local z. Bay 20 ft, two storeys of 20 ft, fixed bases, all members A = 0.2 ft^2, I = 0.1 ft^4, E = 4.176e6 kip/ft^2; 20 kip at the first level and 10 kip at the roof, on the left column line, toward +X. Units kip, ft. First-order analysis with axial deformation. Target of the page: the largest moment, in the lower left column (member 1 of the listing). Reference values: computed here from this statement (verification/derive/vendor_reference.py); the textbook cited by the vendor page was not opened and no number is taken from it.
